items.title: Design in the material you ship
items.excerpt: Designers should understand code the way an architect understands stone: what it can do, not how to cut it. AI now does the cutting, so the same card can be designed in the browser with real data rather than in a static file.

items.title: How to build a brand foundation with AI without losing your craft
items.excerpt: A practical walkthrough of using Claude plus a handful of guardrails to build a brand foundation and design system that developers respect and clients can actually ship.

items.title: Enforcing Accessibility Gates in Component Libraries: plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills Review
items.excerpt: Battle-testing an LLM agent skill set that blocks merges for real WCAG violations in a component library, instead of generating compliant-looking code that breaks screen readers.

items.title: Integrating agency-agents' Design Personas Into a Tailwind Review Pipeline
items.excerpt: What held up and what broke when AI design-reviewer personas from msitarzewski/agency-agents were routed over a Radix + Tailwind v4 design system, including focus and layout-thrash fixes.

items.title: Solid Glass Adds an AI UI Theme to shadcn/ui Projects
items.excerpt: Solid Glass is a GitHub design system that layers a glass-like theme and agent-interface components onto shadcn/ui projects without changing components.

items.title: Kling AI Opens Kling 4.0 to All Users
items.excerpt: Kuaishou's Kling AI opened Kling 4.0 to all users on klingai.com, adding up to 30-second native clips, multi-reference controls, stereo audio with multilingual lip sync, and MCP and CLI workflow hooks; 4K and 10-bit HDR output are due soon.

items.title: What is Apple's Image Playground app for and how do you use it?
items.excerpt: Apple's on-device image generation tool got noteworthy updates this fall; Engadget explains what Image Playground now does and how to use it.

items.title: How to use Google's SynthID AI detection website
items.excerpt: Google's SynthID detector site offers a simple way to check whether an image has been created or manipulated with Google AI, with a few caveats on what it can and cannot verify.

items.title: I pushed Nvidia's RTX Spark to its limits in our favourite creative laptop
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq benchmarks the ASUS ProArt P14 with Nvidia's new RTX Spark chip across creative and local-AI workloads.

items.title: This weird legal case could change how we think of copyright forever
items.excerpt: A legal fight over the Italian Brain Rot meme characters may look like dumb nonsense for kids, but Creative Bloq argues it could have profound effects on copyright in creative work.

items.title: Olivia Rodrigo accused of using AI in expectations music video
items.excerpt: Olivia Rodrigo's expectations music video is facing accusations of AI use after viewers spotted glitches such as Chappell Roan appearing to be missing an arm.

items.title: Meshy Edit, for part-level changes to AI-generated 3D models, launched
items.excerpt: Meshy Edit, built on a new in-house model, lets users lasso a region of a 3D model, describe a change in text (with up to five reference images) and send the result straight to a slicer, keeping the original intact.

items.title: WeeklyVentures launches CADlingo 2.0 with multi-part AI CAD modeling
items.excerpt: The browser-based text-to-CAD service CADlingo 2.0 now generates multi-part assemblies from text descriptions and exports individual parts.

items.title: Autodesk's most ambitious AI play yet
items.excerpt: Autodesk's AI vision goes beyond faster tools: a connected Autodesk Assistant that decides how to solve design tasks for you across its products.

items.title: RoboParty launches open-source RP1 humanoid robot
items.excerpt: RP1 comes in 24-DoF and 30-DoF versions with open hardware designs, motion-control tools and simulation resources for embodied AI research.
